mapper.sql: id, title, summary, content, category_id, author_id, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category_id AS categoryId, b.name AS categoryName, a.author_id AS authorId, c.nick_name AS authorName, a.status, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_content_article a LEFT JOIN t_content_category b ON a.category_id = b.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_sys_user c ON a.author_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.is_deleted = 0
AND a.status = #{status}
